label: early original-phase step right after s/l/y/v/w/x/q, or input 0/g/z
explanation: Almost entirely an original-phase unit (99.7% of mass), concentrated at positions 1-3 (88% of mass at t=1..3); it is essentially silent at the delimiter and during copy, and rare after t=5. It fires most often on the step right after one of the inputs s, l, y, v, w (rate ~0.15-0.20, about 4x lift), less after x and q, and when the input itself is 0, g or z. At t=0 it fires only weakly, on inputs 0/g/z (activation about 0.02-0.07 of max). The largest activations come when a sequence starts with s/l/v/y/w tokens and is followed at t=2-3 by 0, g or z (e.g. s s 0, l s 0); repeated SET tokens build up the activation over several steps. It rarely fires on a repeated token (in_first=0 holds 8% of mass) and fires less often when the sequence has digits other than 0. The predicate catches 76% of active steps and 81% of the mass, but precision is only ~0.48: the activation depends on the hidden state accumulated over several early tokens, which a single previous-token rule does not capture.
